text:
Maya Chen: Heads-up Quick review on IA + deep link contract. Proposal: keep path stable for resource context and push ephemeral UI state into query params. Regroup left nav into: Workspaces / Models / Deployments / Observability / Settings. Add a compact breadcrumb bar above page header with truncation + accessible labels; on mobile collapse to a single pill that opens a bottom sheet. Also add a small copy-link icon on the breadcrumb. Thoughts?

Noah R.: Love the stable-path + params approach. Engineering concerns: back/forward spam if every toggle writes history, and server canonicalization so shared links are clean. Suggest rule: pushState for user-triggered navigations (click on breadcrumb, open panel), replaceState for UI toggles (open/close drawer, sort toggles). Server should strip non-canonical params (dev flags, session hints).

Priya D.: A11y comments: when the breadcrumb changes announce via aria-live polite: "Navigated to Workspaces > ACME > Models > model-abc". Ensure skip-link "skip to main" targets the visible main panel (if right-hand panel is open the skip should land there). Breadcrumbs must be keyboard operable: Enter/Space to activate, last crumb has aria-current="page". Tooltips must be accessible via focus (aria-describedby).

Liam O.: Microcopy + sharing: copy-link should copy a canonicalized URL (server-side canonicalizePermalink). Show a short toast: "Copied canonical link" and include a small preview in the toast for long slugs. On mobile the pill should show truncated text and an explicit "Copy" in the sheet. Also want analytics: breadcrumb_copy, breadcrumb_navigate, permalink_open to track broken permalinks.

Maya Chen: Example permalinks I'm thinking: https://console.redwood.ai/w/acme/models?panel=metrics&metric=latency&range=24h and https://console.redwood.ai/w/acme/models/model-abc?revision=7 We call out that shareable params = panel, metric, revision, range. Non-shareable = debug=true, ui-mode=transient.

Noah R.: Implementation checklist suggestion: - Router middleware to canonicalize queries on SSR - Whitelist of permalinkable params - History manager: push vs replace rules - Copy-link endpoint that returns server-canonicalized URL (helps with ephemeral flags) I'll prototype a tiny middleware and share code sample.

Priya D.: Keyboard behavior details: crumbs are role="link" inside a nav/aria-label="Breadcrumbs"; when focus moves into breadcrumbs do not auto-open flyouts; open on Enter. Ensure focus trapping doesn't occur when bottom sheet opens on mobile; focus should move into sheet and return to invoking element on close. Add e2e tests for skiplink landing and aria-live announcement.

Liam O.: Visual idea: show chevrons and truncate with ellipse, tooltip shows full id + small monospace copy button. For very long model ids show a monospace snippet and a copy icon. On hover show full path; on focus expose aria-label with full path so screen readers read it.

A11yBot: Reminder: run axe + keyboard-only flows. Suggested tests: skiplink lands on active panel, breadcrumb Enter navigates without opening unintended flyouts, aria-live announces path changes, copy-link produces canonical URL.

Maya Chen: Owners/action items: Noah - spike router middleware + history rules (due Mon), Priya - a11y acceptance tests + aria-live text (due Tue), Liam - Figma mocks for desktop crumb and mobile pill + copy flow (due Wed). Can we aim to experiment on a small workspace next sprint?

Noah R.: :thumbsup: I'll add an RFC in eng-platform and a tiny prototype middleware.

Priya D.: I'll add tests to the accessibility checklist and PR template.

Liam O.: Will post Figma link and three copy variants in this thread when ready.

A11yBot: Pinned: "NAV-101: Breadcrumb + permalink accessibility checklist" and scheduled review for next Wed.
